text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

We're digging into one question: what actually breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does?

Pilots are forgiving. Production has real customers, messy edge cases, and a 2 a.m. incident channel.

Joining me on stage:

• Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
• Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which sells evaluation software for AI agents
• Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

I'll be pushing for specifics: what failed, how they found out, and who owned the fix.

Thursday, 6:30 pm, at a co-working space in Chelsea. Free to attend.

RSVP link is in the comments. If you're running agents in production, or about to, come say hi.
